verdict.rationale: Increase's API allows programmatic creation of multiple account numbers (docs-7) and batch retrieval of events instead of webhooks (docs-24), suggesting some multi-item automation, but there's no explicit bulk/batch transfer creation endpoint or documented way to submit many payments in a single call. missing for 10: explicit bulk transfer/batch-create API, documented rate limits or batch endpoints for high-volume operations, independent evidence of bulk usage patterns.
